zodiac.mean: belt of twelve astrological star signs
zodiac.ex: Leo is my sign in the zodiac.
zodiac.mn: zodiac – zoo dekh, saari rashiyan jaanwar jaisi

zany.ex: The film's zany humor kept everyone laughing.
zany.mn: zany – 'Johnny' jaisa comedian, funny aur pagal

zoo.mean: place where wild animals are kept for viewing
zoo.ex: We saw lions and tigers at the zoo.
zoo.mn: zoo – 'ZO' matlab jaanwar, sab animals ek jagah

zealots.mean: fanatical, uncompromising followers of a cause
zealots.ex: Religious zealots refused any form of compromise.
zealots.mn: zealots – zeal se lot (bahut) followers, andhe bhakt

zeal.mean: great energy or enthusiasm for a cause
zeal.ex: She pursued her studies with remarkable zeal.

zoology.ex: He is studying zoology to become a wildlife biologist.
zoology.mn: zoo-logy – zoo ke jaanwaron ka study

zealot.mean: fanatical, uncompromising follower of a cause
zealot.ex: The political zealot refused any compromise.
zealot.mn: zealot – zeal se bhara fanatic bhakt

zoomorphism.mean: depicting gods or things with animal forms
zoomorphism.ex: Ancient Egyptian art shows zoomorphism in its animal-headed gods.
zoomorphism.mn: zoomorphism – zoo=animal, cheez ko animal roop dena

zealous.mean: showing great energy and enthusiasm for something
zealous.ex: She was a zealous supporter of environmental causes.
zealous.mn: zealous – zeal wala banda har kaam josh se karta hai

zoonic.mean: relating to animals or caused by animals
zoonic.ex: Some village diseases are zoonic, spread from animals to people.

zenith.ex: Her career reached its zenith last year.
zenith.mn: zenith – ze-nith, sabse upar top point pe pahunchna

zoophobia.ex: His zoophobia made visiting the farm difficult.
zoophobia.mn: zoophobia – zoo (animals) ka phobia, janwaron se darr
